field_principles.adversarial_clean: States whether the corrected boundary avoids the Exp5527 duration/substrate overclaim.
field_principles.confident_wrong_rate: Separates high-confidence schema-valid failures from calibrated abstention.
field_principles.duration_floor_s: Records the adversarial plausibility floor for live SOTA local-GGUF claims.
field_principles.exact_validator_accuracy: Reports deterministic Exp5499 correctness only for schema-valid rows.
field_principles.field_principles: Explains why each headline and gate field must remain present.
field_principles.gpu_offload_evidence: Records the runtime/offload substrate instead of trusting model-name strings.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Provides a terminal status without promoting too-short, missing, or schema-invalid evidence.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Declares live local SOTA GGUF execution or explicit claim downgrade semantics.
field_principles.live_model_invoked: Separates real local-GGUF execution from evidence downgrades.
field_principles.measured_duration_s: Records the wall-clock receipt used to authenticate or downgrade the claim.
field_principles.missing_candidate_rows: Keeps absent rows visible and prevents missing rows from becoming abstentions.
field_principles.model_specs: Names the mandated GGUF set so the corrigendum cannot swap in legacy smoke models as headline evidence.
field_principles.models_attempted: Identifies which mandated model, if any, received the live prompt.
field_principles.no_quality_claim_if_not_live: Prevents missing live execution from inheriting Exp5527 quality metrics.
field_principles.preference_optimality_rate: Reports soft optimality only after exact hard-constraint validation.
field_principles.quality_claim_allowed: States whether this corrigendum opens a downstream hard/soft SOTA quality claim.
field_principles.readiness_blockers: Lists the exact gates preventing claim authentication.
field_principles.rows_emitted: Separates model output volume from correctness or quality.
field_principles.rows_requested: Fixes the Exp5527 fixture denominator before parsing.
field_principles.schema_validity_rate: Gates exact-validator handoff on schema-valid rows.
field_principles.sota_panel_duration_corrigendum_ready: States whether the boundary repair is complete enough for downstream gates.
field_principles.tests_added_or_reused: Links the artifact to parser, duration, substrate, and exact-validator tests.
field_principles.upstream_panel_path: Pins the artifact whose duration/substrate boundary is being repaired.
